ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what are the predatory nematodes consumed by?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a soil food web, with a box labeled "Predatory Nematodes" in the upper right area, and a box labeled "Predatory Mites" below it and slightly to the right. In the image, arrows connect different organisms, indicating food web relationships. Reasoning: The question asks what consumes predatory nematodes. According to the arrow convention in the diagram, arrows go from the organism being eaten to the consumer, for example the plant parts point to nematodes that feed on plants. Following the arrow pointing outward from "Predatory Nematodes," it can be seen that it points to "Predatory Mites." Therefore, predatory nematodes are consumed by predatory mites.
